definition.en: An intensely painful feeling or experience of believing we are flawed and therefore unworthy of acceptance and belonging.

en: Shame is a psycho-social-cultural construct. The psychological component relates to the participants’ emphasis on the emotions, thoughts, and behaviours of self. The social component relates to the way people experience shame in an interpersonal context that is inextricably tied to relationships and connection. The cultural component points to the very prevalent role of cultural expectations and the relationship between shame and the real or perceived failure of meeting cultural expectations.
